title: Drag-and-Drop — Cards Within/Across Columns + Column Reorder
description: Drag cards to reorder within a column and to move across columns (changing status), and reorder columns, updating the cardOrder / columnOrder arrays deterministically.
spec:
1. Drag a card to a new position within the same column; verify cardOrder updates to match
2. Drag a card from one column to another; verify it is removed from the source cardOrder and inserted into the target cardOrder at the drop index
3. Verify the card columnId is updated to the target column
4. Verify dropping a card renders it at the exact drop position, not just appended
5. Reorder columns by dragging; verify board.columnOrder updates
6. Verify a drag that is cancelled/dropped outside leaves state unchanged
7. Verify dragging the only card out of a column leaves an empty but valid column
8. Verify no duplicate ids appear in any order array after moves
9. Verify within-column reorder persists across reload
10. Verify cross-column move persists across reload
11. Verify there are no console errors during drag operations
12. Verify `bun run smoke:qc` passes
